game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Bone Crypt Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before slime blobs overload Bone Crypt.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Crypt, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before slime blobs overload Bone Crypt. Each round, slime blobs strike the exit ledge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from slime blobs in Bone Crypt: keep the loop_safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

code_snippet:

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Bone Crypt.
